idea: Nursing Home Inspection & Deficiency Tracker — Cross-linked CMS data on deficiencies, penalties, ownership (incl PE/REIT), staffing, quality measures
research_notes: 6+ CMS CSV datasets freely downloadable. PE ownership disclosure rule (Nov 2023) creates timely hook. ProPublica covers deficiencies only. No free product cross-links ownership+deficiencies+penalties+staffing+quality. Buyers: PE firms, REITs, elder law attorneys, journalists, academics.

idea: EPA Toxic Release Inventory Cross-Linked with Health & Demographics — Facility-level toxic releases cross-linked with county health outcomes, Census demographics, and EJScreen data
research_notes: Researched 2026-03-02. All government CSV/API sources, no scraping needed. 80,000+ TRI facilities, 3,143 counties with health data, 74,000+ Census tracts. Cross-links: TRI releases -> County Health Rankings -> Census demographics -> EJScreen. No free open cross-linked database exists. Highest score of all ideas ever evaluated (28/30). Environmental justice has top-tier academic/media/policy relevance. Potential collaboration with Dr. Robert Bullard. Full brief at state/research_briefs/epa_tri_health.md.

idea: CFPB Consumer Complaint Cross-Linked Analysis — Cross-link 2M+ CFPB complaints with FDIC institution data, CRA ratings, and enforcement actions
research_notes: Researched 2026-03-02. CFPB bulk CSV/API tested (2M+ complaints). FDIC BankFind API tested and working (4,600+ banks). FFIEC CRA ratings available quarterly. CFPB enforcement actions scrapeable (300+ since 2012). Cross-linking IS the value proposition — match company names across CFPB/FDIC/FFIEC/enforcement. Named buyers: Ncontracts, Wolters Kluwer, Cornerstone Advisors, S&P Global, Klaros Group. Full brief at state/research_briefs/cfpb_cross_linked.md.

idea: Corporate Subsidiary & Ownership Mapping from SEC EDGAR Exhibit 21 Filings
research_notes: Researched 2026-03-02. SEC EDGAR Full-Text Search API returned 1,052 Exhibit 21 filings for H1 2024 alone. Submissions API tested with Apple (CIK 320193). Sample Exhibit 21 HTML (Abbott Labs) confirmed parseable. sec-api.io is a paid competitor (100K+ subsidiary lists) but no FREE open database exists. HTML format variation is main challenge. Conditional accept — start after EPA TRI and CFPB. Named buyers: Moody's/BvD, D&B, Middesk, Dow Jones R&C, LexisNexis. Full brief at state/research_briefs/sec_subsidiary_mapping.md.

idea: State Medical Board Disciplinary Actions Tracker — Cross-state database of physician discipline cross-linked with NPI, OIG exclusions, CMS Open Payments
research_notes: Researched 2026-03-02. FSMB DocInfo provides free individual lookups but no bulk access. California MBC returned 404 redirect on test. Each of 50+ state boards uses different format (HTML tables, PDFs, newsletters). Technical feasibility (2/5) is the critical weakness — would need 50+ custom scrapers. Score above threshold at 21 but lower priority than EPA TRI (28), CFPB (26), SEC Subsidiary (23). Consider starting with 5-10 most accessible states. Named buyers: Doximity, Definitive Healthcare, Symplr, Verifiable. Full brief at state/research_briefs/medical_board_disciplinary.md.

idea: State PUC Rate Case Tracker — Utility rate case filings and decisions across state public utility commissions
research_notes: Only competitor is S&P RRA at $30K+/year via Capital IQ. Data scattered across 50+ state PUC websites. Start with 8-10 large states. Buyers: clean energy cos, consulting firms, consumer advocates, law firms, academics.

idea: Infrastructure Project Cost Overrun Tracker — Federal and state DOT project data tracking estimates vs actuals
research_notes: Conditional accept. Strong idea but technical feasibility is low (2/5). Data in PDFs, MS Access, scattered state DOT portals. Revisit after top 2 projects are underway.

idea: NHTSA Vehicle Safety Defect Tracker — Cross-linked complaints, investigations, recalls, TSBs, and manufacturer communications with full defect lifecycle tracing
research_notes: Researched 2026-03-03. ALL APIs tested and working: complaints (391 results for Tesla Model 3 2023), recalls (10 campaigns), investigations (4,159 total). Flat file downloads include FLAT_CMPL.zip (1949-present, updated daily), FLAT_RCL.zip, FLAT_TSBS.zip, FLAT_INV.zip. No free product cross-links the full defect lifecycle (complaint clusters -> investigation triggers -> recall outcomes -> TSB remedies). OEMDTC.com is a web viewer only, not a structured data product. 2M+ total records across 5 datasets. Named buyers: lemon law firms, auto insurers (Verisk, LexisNexis Risk Solutions), fleet managers, product liability firms. Full brief at state/research_briefs/nhtsa_vehicle_safety.md.

idea: Employer Labor Compliance Tracker — Cross-linked DOL WHD wage violations, NLRB unfair labor practice charges, OSHA citations, employer entity resolution with composite compliance scoring
research_notes: Researched 2026-03-03. Good Jobs First Violation Tracker is a partial competitor (114K+ WHD entries, OSHA 5K+ entries) but lacks entity resolution, NLRB cases, and composite scoring. DOL WHD data available via data.gov (concluded actions since FY2005, ~23-30K/year). NLRB Advanced Data Search exports up to 100K records; labordata/nlrb-data GitHub repo has daily-refreshed data since 2010 (20-30K charges/year). OSHA inspection data via DOL bulk CSV (3M+ inspections). EEOC data more limited at case level. Timely: DOL 'Project Firewall' (Sept 2025) created inter-agency H-1B enforcement coordination. Named buyers: immigration law firms (Fragomen, BAL), compliance platforms (Navex Global), ESG investors, union campaigns, employment law firms. Full brief at state/research_briefs/employer_labor_compliance.md.

idea: HUD Affordable Housing Compliance Tracker — Cross-linked LIHTC properties, REAC inspection scores, Section 8 contracts, and ownership data for all federally-subsidized housing
research_notes: Researched 2026-03-03. HUD LIHTC database: 54,102 projects, 3.7M units (CSV/Access download). REAC inspection scores downloadable CSV (~20K inspections/year, scored 0-100). Section 8 contracts on data.hud.gov. HUD acknowledges internal cross-linking but does NOT release the cross-linked dataset. NLIHC's NHPD is closest competitor but lacks inspection scores and detailed ownership. Novogradac maps LIHTC but no cross-linking. 400K+ records from 4+ sources. Named buyers: housing developers (Enterprise, LISC), state HFAs, LIHTC syndicators (Raymond James), policy researchers (Urban Institute, Brookings), journalism (ProPublica, Marshall Project). Full brief at state/research_briefs/hud_affordable_housing.md.

idea: H-1B Employer Compliance Tracker — Cross-linked DOL LCA data, USCIS approval/denial rates, WHD enforcement actions, and willful violator lists for H-1B sponsors
research_notes: Researched 2026-03-03. h1bdata.info indexes 4.8M+ LCA records but no enforcement cross-link. USCIS Employer Data Hub provides approval/denial rates (CSV, FY2009-2026Q1) but no wage data. DOL WHD has compliance actions since FY2005. DOL publishes H-1B willful violator list. No product combines LCA wages + USCIS outcomes + WHD violations. EXTREMELY timely: Project Firewall (Sept 2025) is DOL's most aggressive H-1B enforcement ever — 175+ active investigations, $15M back wages. EEOC partnered Dec 2025. Immigration is top political issue. Buyer urgency is highest of all new ideas. Scored 23 — accept but lower priority than NHTSA (25) and labor compliance (24) due to partial data gap (h1bdata.info covers base layer). Full brief at state/research_briefs/h1b_employer_compliance.md.

idea: PHMSA Pipeline Safety Incident Tracker — Cross-linked pipeline incidents, enforcement actions, operator data, with community impact demographics
research_notes: Researched 2026-03-03. PHMSA provides extensive CSV/ZIP downloads: incident flagged files (20+ years, 4 pipeline types), operator annual reports (OpID system), enforcement data (NOPVs, corrective actions). $6B+ property damage, 306 casualties over 20 years. Pipeline Safety Trust has basic monthly dashboard but no structured cross-linked product. No product connects incidents -> enforcement -> operator profiles -> community demographics. 20K+ records from 4+ sources. Named buyers: environmental law firms, insurance/reinsurance (Swiss Re, Munich Re), energy consultants, ESG researchers. Full brief at state/research_briefs/phmsa_pipeline_safety.md.

idea: CPSC Product Safety & Recall Tracker — Cross-linked CPSC recalls, SaferProducts.gov incident reports, NEISS injury data, manufacturer/importer tracking
research_notes: Researched 2026-03-03. CPSC Recalls API tested and working (JSON, 1973-present). SaferProducts.gov API (OData) available. NEISS provides ER injury surveillance data. No product cross-links recalls -> incident reports -> injury data -> manufacturer history. 50K+ direct recall/incident records plus 400K+ NEISS estimates. Named buyers: product liability firms, retail compliance teams (Amazon, Walmart), product testing labs (UL, Intertek), insurance. Full brief at state/research_briefs/cpsc_product_recall.md.

idea: FCC Broadband & Telecom Complaint Tracker — Cross-linked FCC consumer complaints with broadband deployment data
rejection_reason: Researched 2026-03-03. Below 20-point threshold. FCC complaint data is already well-structured and accessible via API and open data portal. BroadbandNow and similar sites aggregate coverage data. Cross-linking adds limited incremental value. Consumer advocacy buyers are budget-constrained. Telecom analysts use paid Bloomberg/S&P data. Full brief at state/research_briefs/fcc_broadband_complaints.md.
research_notes: FCC Consumer Complaints API at fcc.gov/consumer-help-center-api. Open data at opendata.fcc.gov. BDC data at broadbandmap.fcc.gov. Data is already reasonably structured and accessible.

idea: Building Code Violation Tracker — Cross-city aggregation of building code violations, inspections, and complaints
rejection_reason: Researched 2026-03-02. At exactly 20/30 threshold but rejected in favor of higher-scoring alternatives. City-level data already structured (Socrata APIs) — we'd be doing aggregation/standardization, not structuring unstructured data. Cross-linking value (3/5) is weaker than other candidates. Buyer clarity (3/5) limited — no standout paying organization. Credibility signal (3/5) is modest. Full brief at state/research_briefs/building_code_violations.md.
research_notes: Researched 2026-03-02. Chicago (800K+ violations on Socrata), NYC (DOB/HPD/ECB datasets on Open Data), Philadelphia (OpenDataPhilly). LA and Houston have limited open data. ViolationWatch.nyc and DOBGuard are NYC-only competitors. No cross-city aggregation exists but the standardization challenge (different code systems per city) is the main work, not data extraction.

idea: State Cannabis License & Enforcement Tracker — Cannabis business licenses, violations, and enforcement across legalized states
rejection_reason: Researched 2026-03-02. Borderline at 20/30 but rejected. Emerald Intel is a direct well-funded competitor. Cannabis remains federally illegal — reputational risk for Nathan's professional brand. Each state requires custom work. Buyer universe is smaller/more niche. Other candidates score higher. Revisit if federal legalization advances. Full brief at state/research_briefs/cannabis_license_tracker.md.
research_notes: California DCC has data dashboards and license search (React SPA with API backend). Massachusetts CCC publishes open data. Emerald Intel tracks 4,372+ new licenses in 2025. Dan K Reports does legislation tracking. Husch Blackwell has a regulatory map. No unified structured license + enforcement database but Emerald Intel is close.

idea: State Lobbying Disclosure Aggregator — Aggregate state-level lobbying registration and expenditure data from all 50 states
rejection_reason: Researched 2026-03-02. OpenSecrets already aggregates state lobbying data for 20 states. FollowTheMoney.org is building a 50-state database. Only 19/50 states provide meaningful electronic disclosure. Montana reverted to paper forms in 2019. These well-funded nonprofits have years of head start and dedicated teams. Technical feasibility is low (50 different state systems). Full brief at state/research_briefs/state_lobbying_disclosure.md.
research_notes: OpenSecrets covers 20 states in their state lobbying dropdown. FollowTheMoney (National Institute on Money in State Politics) is working toward 50-state coverage. NCSL has a legislation database but not expenditure data. Many states use paper forms or proprietary web apps with no standard schema.

idea: Insurance Rate Filing Tracker — Cross-state insurance rate filing data from SERFF and state DOI websites
rejection_reason: Deep research revised score from 21 to 17. S&P Global RateFilings.com has 2M+ filings (strong competitor). SERFF returns 403 (primary multi-state data source blocked). Most state DOI sites are JS-heavy SPAs or return 403. Only FL IRFS and CMS health rate data are accessible. Technical feasibility dropped to 2/5. Below 20-point threshold.
research_notes: Researched 2026-03-02. Scaffolded project before research completed. SERFF returns 403. CA DOI is Oracle APEX (JS). TX DOI, NY DFS sites require browser rendering. Only FL OIR and CMS health data bulk CSVs accessible. Abandoned scaffold at projects/insurance-rate-tracker/.

idea: FDA MAUDE Medical Device Adverse Event Tracker
rejection_reason: Deep research confirms prior rejection. openFDA provides free structured JSON APIs for all 9 device endpoints. DeviceEvents (17.4M reports), Redica Systems (200+ customers), Clarivate, and IQVIA all serve this market. High feasibility signals low defensibility.
research_notes: Full brief at state/research_briefs/fda_maude.md.

idea: OSHA Workplace Inspection & Citation Tracker
rejection_reason: DOL provides bulk CSV downloads and REST API. Violation Tracker by Good Jobs First already aggregates across 39 agencies.
research_notes: 3M+ inspections already structured.

idea: Federal Research Grant Award Tracker
rejection_reason: NIH RePORTER API, NSF Award Search API, Dimensions.ai already cover this comprehensively.
research_notes: Government APIs freely available.

idea: Clinical Trial Site Performance Tracker
rejection_reason: AACT database already provides complete relational database of ClinicalTrials.gov.
research_notes: Citeline charges six figures but uses proprietary data we cannot replicate.

idea: Title IX Investigation & Resolution Tracker
rejection_reason: Chronicle tracker and Title IX for All already cover this. OCR enforcement collapsed in 2025.
research_notes: 177 resolutions in 2025 vs 518 in 2024.

idea: Federal Agency FOIA Response Tracker
rejection_reason: FOIA.gov provides structured CSVs. MuckRock and TRAC already track request-level data. No commercial buyers.
research_notes: Target audience is budget-constrained nonprofits.

idea: Municipal Bond Issuance & Default Tracker
rejection_reason: EMMA provides free access. Bloomberg and DPC DATA dominate. Bulk MSRB data requires paid subscription.
research_notes: All buyer segments already served.

idea: University Endowment Alternative Investment Tracker
rejection_reason: PitchBook, Preqin, Burgiss dominate. Most universities block fund-level disclosure. Too similar to Pension Fund Tracker.
research_notes: Only 5-10 endowments disclose fund names.

idea: MSHA Mining Safety & Enforcement Tracker — Cross-linked mine inspections, violations, penalties, accidents/injuries, and operator profiles from MSHA Open Government datasets
research_notes: Researched 2026-03-04. 20+ bulk datasets freely downloadable from arlweb.msha.gov. ALL tested and working (HTTP 200). Core datasets: Mines (91,587), Accidents (271,621), Inspections (1,137,929), Violations (3,055,941), Assessed Violations (2,989,669), Civil Penalties (477,094). Total ~8M+ records. $1.8B in proposed penalties, 1,194 fatalities, 2,456 permanent disabilities. MINE_ID is universal FK across all datasets. Pipe-delimited text in ZIP files, headers included. No auth, no CAPTCHA, no bot protection. No cross-linked product exists. Full brief at state/research_briefs/msha_mining_safety.md.

idea: FAA/NTSB Aviation Safety & Accident Tracker
rejection_reason: Below 20-point threshold. Cirium and FlightAware already serve the aviation data market. NTSB data available as Access DB download but limited cross-linking value. Aviation safety buyers already well-served by paid products.
research_notes: NTSB provides avall.zip (Access DB) with all accidents since 1982. CAROL query tool enables CSV export. FAA SDR data less accessible. Competition from Cirium, FlightAware, AviationDB is strong.

idea: FDA/USDA Food Safety Inspection & Enforcement Tracker
rejection_reason: Below 20-point threshold. openFDA already provides structured JSON APIs for food enforcement/recall data (2004-present). Data is already well-structured and searchable. Cross-linking adds limited incremental value. Competition from openFDA itself makes this non-defensible.
research_notes: openFDA food enforcement API tested — weekly updates, searchable. FSIS inspection data also available. But the data gap is minimal since openFDA is already structured and free.
